title: Review all of a session's edits in the Claude pane, like /diff
notes: Claude Code: /diff opens a review of all edits. SDK: none; /diff sent as a prompt likely answers "not available", unverified. Build from the session's Edit/Write calls or git diff of the cwd. If not feasible, comment on the card and stop without a PR. Size M.

comments.body: Shipped /diff as the screen's own command, built from the session's Edit/Write/MultiEdit calls that worked (src/chat-diff.ts), grouped by file. PR #111.
Shipped in PR #111: /diff reviews every file changed in the conversation. Merged after 3 review rounds.
